text: Ɓen yedduɓe Alla wi'i: "Ko hanno jippinee e dow Nulaaɗo on ndee Alqur'aanaare laawol gootol, hara nde jippinaaka e makko ko nde senndaande? seKo wano nii Men jippinii Alqur'aanaare nden ko nde serndaande fii tabintingol ɓernde maaɗa nden -an Nulaaɗo- sabu jippagol mayre laawol ɓaawo laawol, Men jippinii nde seeɗa seeɗa fii newinngol faamugol nde e hunnjagol nde.
